physical.title: Parallel beam entering the curved face of a hemisphere

interpretation.requestedResult: Measure the sampled light-ray positions on the flat face in a meridional section.
stated: The A14 hemisphere radius is twice the incident beam radius; the glass index is 1.5.
assumptions: The meridional section uses a 100 mm radius and an exterior of index 1. The source is placed at x=200 mm with an assumed relative brightness of 0.08. Native ray density 0.2 sets the numerical sampling. Partial reflection is disabled. The table is omitted.
unknowns: Continuous illuminated radius on the table.
